remarks: MAGNIFICENT OPPORTUNITY in the desirable Stonebrook community located in the ever popular Mid-Ridges neighborhood, one of Stamford's most sought-after communities. Just minutes from the Merritt Parkway, Sterling Farms golf course, Trader Joe's and tons of local shopping, restaurants, schools and so much more. Stonebrook boasts a low maintenance lifestyle and very reasonable HOA (just $430 per month). This home has been totally refreshed and is move in ready! The open and airy main level features an eat in kitchen (with all new, never used appliances). The kitchen/dining area with cozy gas fireplace  leads outside to the expansive rear deck with yard making entertaining a pleasure. The main level also features a living room with soaring ceilings, a cozy den office, powder room, laundry and garage access. The second floor offers a primary suite with oversized bath and a generous walk in closet ready for your custom closet to be installed. There are two additional bedrooms and a hall bath. There is room in the main foyer to add an elevator if one desires. Additional positives include gas heat, huge attic storage, plenty of guest parking and beautifully maintained grounds. Live your best here at Stonebrook!
